description: Release denylist rules for the nself CLI. Any rule that triggers blocks `gh release create` unless --skip-denylist is provided with a logged justification. Maintained under P101 S8.T05.

rules.name: signature-check
rules.rationale: Unsigned release artifacts cannot be verified by downstream consumers (Homebrew tap, supply-chain auditors). Sigstore keyless signing via OIDC is required (release.yml step `Sign artifacts with cosign`).
rules.remediation: Re-run the release workflow with `id-token: write` permission and ensure cosign step completes for every dist tarball + checksums.txt.

rules.name: missing-sbom
rules.rationale: Each release MUST publish SPDX + CycloneDX SBOMs (Q04 requirement). Without them, vulnerability scanners cannot resolve transitive dependencies, and supply-chain audits fail.
rules.remediation: Confirm the `sbom` job in release.yml completed and uploaded both artifacts before tagging.

rules.name: zero-commits-since-prior-tag
rules.rationale: Releasing with no commits since the previous tag is almost always a mistake (accidental re-tag, fat-finger). Real releases have at least one commit (version bump).
rules.remediation: Confirm the version bump commit is present. If intentionally retagging (rare), use --skip-denylist with an explicit justification.

rules.name: failed-license-scan
rules.rationale: AGPL/SSPL/GPL-3-only dependencies are forbidden in the MIT-licensed CLI. The license-audit workflow must pass before release to avoid shipping incompatible licenses to end users.
rules.check: gh run list --workflow license-audit.yml --branch <tag> --limit 1 --json conclusion -q '.[0].conclusion' | grep -q success
rules.remediation: Address all flagged licenses in the latest license-audit.yml run. See `.claude/docs/operations/agpl-sspl-policy.md`.

rules.name: no-milestone-closed
rules.rationale: Every release must correspond to a closed GitHub milestone documenting the user-visible changes. Releases without a milestone leave operators blind to what changed.
rules.check: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/milestones --jq '.[] | select(.title=="<version>" and .state=="closed")' | grep -q .
rules.remediation: Create or close the milestone matching the release version (e.g., `v1.0.13`). Attach all relevant issues + PRs before retrying.

behaviors: Mark GitHub release as draft (gh release edit <tag> --draft)
Append RETRACTED notice + reason to release notes
Optionally delete the git tag locally + remote (with --delete-tag flag and confirm prompt)
Emit follow-up PCI to plugins-pro + admin + homebrew-nself inboxes for cascade rollback
